correctness.rationale: The 24-variable coefficient space has rank-nine rational incidence conditions, independently generated as a 15-dimensional rational-point ideal. Both procedures yield exactly 32,768 filling forms and 5,832 rationally smooth ones. Complete group-orbit enumeration gives 206 screening orbits; exact four-chart Gröbner basis unit-ideal checks give 76 smooth orbits and 2,304 equations. A second standard-library Buchberger implementation checks all 5,832 screened equations without orbit reduction, reproducing 2,304. Positive intersection and adjunction prove geometric integrality and genus eight.

value.rationale: The sharp first nonminimal asymmetric bidegree above the Homma–Kim (3,4) binary minimal case is a canonical genus-eight family with the largest possible rational point set on the split quadric. Its exact 76-orbit and stabilizer distribution classifies a natural arithmetic embedding property, while 5,832 versus 2,304 isolates the substantive geometric smoothness obstruction. The exact invariant can serve as a finite baseline for arithmetic moduli and filling-curve constructions, without claiming an abstract genus-eight census.
